question: Should OpenClaw support Android/Termux as a Gateway host, or should Android remain a companion node with external/mobile-first Gateway-hosting projects kept outside core?
rationale: The code and docs intentionally exclude Android from managed Gateway hosting today, and adding support would set platform, service lifecycle, background execution, dashboard exposure, and security policy for mobile devices.

options.title: Scope a supported Android host design
options.body: Keep this issue open while Android and Gateway owners define a narrow foreground or service-hosting mode, security constraints, docs, and real-device proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep Android node-only
options.body: Document that official Android remains a companion node and close or redirect Android Gateway-hosting requests to external projects or future product planning.

options.title: Externalize mobile-first hosting
options.body: Treat Android Gateway hosting as an external app/plugin/fork ecosystem path unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Scope a supported Android host design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while Android and Gateway owners define a narrow foreground or service-hosting mode, security constraints, docs, and real-device proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses Gateway lifecycle, security posture, release scope, and Android product direction, and steipete is the project lead with recent Gateway-service and Android-docs history.
